lcc_original: 上帝記起挪亞來，也記起那些同挪亞在樓船裏的一切走獸、一切牲口；上帝叫風吹過地上，水就漸漸消退。
notes: LCC restructures the single Hebrew verb זָכַר (WH02142) into a parallel construction 記起…也記起 for literary effect; only the first 記起 is tagged since Hebrew has one verb with multiple objects; 也記起 left unannotated.
LCC 那些 is a demonstrative pronoun added for fluency with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
UNV 挪亞<WAH0854> represents the Hebrew pronoun אִתּוֹ (with him); LCC expresses this as 同挪亞, with WAH0854 attached to 挪亞 following UNV convention of tagging the content noun.
Hebrew בַּתֵּבָה is split in LCC into two words: 在 takes WAH09002 (inseparable preposition בְּ) and 樓船 takes WH08392 (noun תֵּבָה), since LCC makes the preposition explicit.
UNV has {<WH05921>} implicit for Hebrew עַל (over/upon); LCC makes it explicit as 上 in 地上, so tag is applied directly per Rule 3: 地<WH0776>上<WH05921>.
UNV {<WAH03605>} before 牲畜 is implicit; LCC has explicit 一切 before 牲口, so braces dropped per Rule 3.
First {<WAH0853>} (before 挪亞) and second {<WAH0853>} (וְאֵת conjunction+object-marker before cattle group) both remain implicit—LCC has no explicit content word for either.
WH00 on 叫 preserved as-is from UNV (FHL causative-construction marker for the Hiphil; meaning opaque but duplication of WH05674 across 叫 and 吹過 is the FHL convention for Chinese causative split).
LCC 來 (after 挪亞) and 就 (before 消退) are Chinese aspect/conjunctive particles with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
